cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16...3.31)
project(CyUI VERSION 1.2.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

# Catalog edits must rebuild Core even when a compiler's include scanner cannot
# discover generated .inc dependencies (for example localized MSVC output).
set_property(SOURCE src/Theme.cpp APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/cyui/detail/LocaleFrench.inc")

# A host's plain set(CYUI_...) before add_subdirectory() must win over the cache defaults
# below, on the first configure too: otherwise the bundled ImGui is linked next to the
# host's. CMake 3.21+ does this with CMP0126; cyui_cache_default() does it on 3.16-3.20.
if(POLICY CMP0126)
    cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 NEW)
endif()
macro(cyui_cache_default name value type doc)
    if(DEFINED ${name} AND NOT DEFINED CACHE{${name}})
        set(_cyui_host_value "${${name}}")
        set(${name} "${value}" CACHE ${type} "${doc}")
        set(${name} "${_cyui_host_value}")
        unset(_cyui_host_value)
    else()
        set(${name} "${value}" CACHE ${type} "${doc}")
    endif()
endmacro()

# Select only the modules needed by the host; CyUI::CyUI preserves the umbrella API.
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET "" STRING "An existing Dear ImGui target to link (empty: build the bundled copy)")
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_IMGUI_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/imgui" PATH "Dear ImGui sources, when no target is given")
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(CYUI_TOP_LEVEL ON)
else()
    set(CYUI_TOP_LEVEL OFF)
endif()
option(CYUI_BUILD_DEMO "Build the Win32 + DX11 demo" ${CYUI_TOP_LEVEL})
option(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO "Build the optional audio controls" ON)
option(CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY "Build the optional gallery and theme editor" ON)
option(CYUI_BUILD_TESTS "Build CyUI module integration tests" OFF)
if(CYUI_BUILD_DEMO AND CYUI_TOP_LEVEL)
    set(CYUI_DEFAULT_MODULES "All")
else()
    set(CYUI_DEFAULT_MODULES "")
endif()
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_MODULES "${CYUI_DEFAULT_MODULES}" STRING "Optional modules, semicolon separated, or All")
# Audio and Gallery keep their own options (ON by default for existing hosts); naming them
# in CYUI_MODULES turns them on too.
if("Audio" IN_LIST CYUI_MODULES)
    set(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO ON)
endif()
if("Gallery" IN_LIST CYUI_MODULES)
    set(CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY ON)
endif()


if(CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET STREQUAL "")
    if(NOT TARGET cyui_imgui)
        add_library(cyui_imgui STATIC
            ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui.cpp
            ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
            ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
            ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp)
        if(CYUI_BUILD_DEMO)
            target_sources(cyui_imgui PRIVATE ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/imgui_demo.cpp)
        endif()
        target_include_directories(cyui_imgui PUBLIC ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR})
        target_compile_features(cyui_imgui PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
        set_target_properties(cyui_imgui PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    endif()
    set(CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET cyui_imgui)
elseif(NOT TARGET ${CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET must name an existing Dear ImGui target")
endif()

function(cyui_configure_target target)
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    target_compile_features(${target} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8 /EHsc)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
    endif()
endfunction()

add_library(cyui_core STATIC src/Theme.cpp src/Widgets.cpp src/Layout.cpp src/Filter.cpp)
add_library(CyUI::Core ALIAS cyui_core)
target_include_directories(cyui_core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(cyui_core PUBLIC ${CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET})
cyui_configure_target(cyui_core)

if(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO)
    add_library(cyui_audio STATIC src/modules/Audio.cpp)
    add_library(CyUI::Audio ALIAS cyui_audio)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_audio PUBLIC CyUI::Core)
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_audio PUBLIC CYUI_HAS_AUDIO=1)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_audio)
endif()

set(CYUI_KNOWN_MODULES Canvas Plots Curves Nodes Timeline AudioViews Code Diff CodeEditor Inspector Assets Images Viewport Commands Diagnostics DocumentViews Web)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Plots Canvas)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Curves Plots)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Nodes Canvas)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Timeline Canvas)
set(CYUI_DEPS_AudioViews Plots)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Diff Code)
set(CYUI_DEPS_CodeEditor Code)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Images Canvas)
set(CYUI_DEPS_Viewport Images)
set(CYUI_DEPS_DocumentViews Code)
function(cyui_require_module module)
    get_property(enabled GLOBAL PROPERTY CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES)
    if(module IN_LIST enabled)
        return()
    endif()
    if(NOT module IN_LIST CYUI_KNOWN_MODULES)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown CyUI module: ${module}")
    endif()
    foreach(dependency IN LISTS CYUI_DEPS_${module})
        cyui_require_module(${dependency})
    endforeach()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES ${module})
endfunction()
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES "")
foreach(module IN LISTS CYUI_MODULES)
    if(module STREQUAL "All")
        foreach(known IN LISTS CYUI_KNOWN_MODULES)
            cyui_require_module(${known})
        endforeach()
    elseif(NOT module MATCHES "^(Core|Audio|Gallery|)$")
        cyui_require_module(${module})
    endif()
endforeach()
get_property(CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES GLOBAL PROPERTY CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES)
foreach(module IN LISTS CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES)
    string(TOLOWER "${module}" lower)
    string(TOUPPER "${module}" upper)
    add_library(cyui_${lower} STATIC src/modules/${module}.cpp)
    add_library(CyUI::${module} ALIAS cyui_${lower})
    target_link_libraries(cyui_${lower} PUBLIC CyUI::Core)
    foreach(dependency IN LISTS CYUI_DEPS_${module})
        target_link_libraries(cyui_${lower} PUBLIC CyUI::${dependency})
    endforeach()
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_${lower} PUBLIC CYUI_HAS_${upper}=1)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_${lower})
endforeach()
if(TARGET cyui_diff)
    add_library(CyUI::Code::Diff ALIAS cyui_diff)
endif()
if(TARGET cyui_code)
    # Pure lexical engines only: no Scintilla widget, OS backend or network fetch.
    file(GLOB CYUI_LEXER_SUPPORT CONFIGURE_DEPENDS third_party/lexilla/lexlib/*.cxx)
    file(GLOB CYUI_LEXER_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS third_party/lexilla/lexers/*.cxx)
    add_library(cyui_code_lexers STATIC ${CYUI_LEXER_SUPPORT} ${CYUI_LEXER_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(cyui_code_lexers PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/lexilla/lexlib
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/lexilla/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/scintilla/include)
    target_compile_features(cyui_code_lexers PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
    set_target_properties(cyui_code_lexers PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(cyui_code_lexers PRIVATE /utf-8 /EHsc)
    endif()
    target_sources(cyui_code PRIVATE src/modules/code/CodeSyntax.cpp src/modules/code/LanguageData.cpp src/modules/code/LexDocument.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_code PRIVATE cyui_code_lexers)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_code PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_code PUBLIC CYUI_CODE_LANGUAGE_CATALOGUE=1)
endif()
if(TARGET cyui_codeeditor)
    add_library(cyui_texteditor STATIC third_party/texteditor/TextEditor.cpp)
    target_include_directories(cyui_texteditor PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/texteditor)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_texteditor PUBLIC ${CYUI_IMGUI_TARGET})
    target_compile_features(cyui_texteditor PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(cyui_texteditor PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(cyui_codeeditor PUBLIC cyui_texteditor)
endif()
if(TARGET cyui_diagnostics)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_diagnostics PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
endif()

# CEF is optional and host-supplied. No network download during configuration.
option(CYUI_BUILD_WEB_CEF "Build the cross-platform off-screen CEF backend" OFF)
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_CEF_ROOT "" PATH "Extracted CEF binary distribution for the target OS/architecture")
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_CEF_TARGET "" STRING "Existing host CEF target (including its C++ wrapper)")
if(CYUI_BUILD_WEB_CEF)
    if(NOT TARGET cyui_web)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "WebCEF requires CYUI_MODULES containing Web")
    endif()
    if(CYUI_CEF_TARGET STREQUAL "")
        if(NOT EXISTS "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}/cmake/FindCEF.cmake")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Set CYUI_CEF_ROOT to a CEF binary distribution, or CYUI_CEF_TARGET to a host target")
        endif()
        set(CEF_ROOT "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}")
        list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CEF_ROOT}/cmake")
        cyui_cache_default(CEF_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_FLAG "" STRING "CEF wrapper CRT override; empty uses the host default")
        find_package(CEF REQUIRED)
        add_subdirectory("${CEF_LIBCEF_DLL_WRAPPER_PATH}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cef_wrapper" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
        add_library(cyui_cef_runtime INTERFACE)
        target_include_directories(cyui_cef_runtime SYSTEM INTERFACE "${CEF_ROOT}")
        foreach(cef_define IN LISTS CEF_COMPILER_DEFINES)
            if(cef_define MATCHES "^CEF_")
                target_compile_definitions(cyui_cef_runtime INTERFACE ${cef_define})
            endif()
        endforeach()
        target_link_libraries(cyui_cef_runtime INTERFACE libcef_dll_wrapper)
        if(APPLE)
            target_link_libraries(cyui_cef_runtime INTERFACE ${CEF_STANDARD_LIBS})
        else()
            target_link_libraries(cyui_cef_runtime INTERFACE "${CEF_LIB_RELEASE}" ${CEF_STANDARD_LIBS})
        endif()
        set(CYUI_CEF_TARGET cyui_cef_runtime)
    elseif(NOT TARGET ${CYUI_CEF_TARGET})
        message(FATAL_ERROR "CYUI_CEF_TARGET must name an existing target")
    endif()
    add_library(cyui_webcef STATIC src/adapters/WebCEF.cpp)
    add_library(CyUI::WebCEF ALIAS cyui_webcef)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_webcef PUBLIC CyUI::Web ${CYUI_CEF_TARGET})
    target_compile_features(cyui_webcef PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_webcef PUBLIC $<$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>:NOMINMAX>)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_webcef)
    set_target_properties(cyui_webcef PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    add_library(cyui_webcef_bridge SHARED src/adapters/WebCEFBridge.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_webcef_bridge PRIVATE CyUI::WebCEF)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_webcef_bridge)
    add_executable(cyui_webcef_helper examples/cef_helper/main.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_webcef_helper PRIVATE CyUI::WebCEF)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_webcef_helper)
    if(CYUI_BUILD_TESTS)
        add_executable(cyui_test_webcef tests/webcef_smoke.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_test_webcef PRIVATE CyUI::WebCEF)
        cyui_configure_target(cyui_test_webcef)
        if(WIN32 AND NOT CYUI_CEF_ROOT STREQUAL "")
            add_custom_command(TARGET cyui_test_webcef POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}/Release" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:cyui_test_webcef>"
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}/Resources" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:cyui_test_webcef>")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

if(CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY)
    add_library(cyui_gallery STATIC src/Gallery.cpp)
    add_library(CyUI::Gallery ALIAS cyui_gallery)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_gallery PUBLIC CyUI::Core)
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_gallery PUBLIC CYUI_HAS_GALLERY=1)
    if(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_gallery PUBLIC CyUI::Audio)
    endif()
    foreach(module IN LISTS CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_gallery PUBLIC CyUI::${module})
    endforeach()
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_gallery)
endif()

# A 3D gizmo backend is a separate dependency supplied by the scene host.
cyui_cache_default(CYUI_IMGUIZMO_TARGET "" STRING "Existing ImGuizmo target for the optional 3D adapter")
if(NOT CYUI_IMGUIZMO_TARGET STREQUAL "")
    if(NOT TARGET cyui_viewport OR NOT TARGET ${CYUI_IMGUIZMO_TARGET})
        message(FATAL_ERROR "ImGuizmo adapter requires Viewport and a valid host ImGuizmo target")
    endif()
    add_library(cyui_imguizmo STATIC src/adapters/ImGuizmo.cpp)
    add_library(CyUI::ImGuizmo ALIAS cyui_imguizmo)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_imguizmo PUBLIC CyUI::Viewport ${CYUI_IMGUIZMO_TARGET})
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_imguizmo PUBLIC CYUI_HAS_IMGUIZMO=1)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_imguizmo)
    if(TARGET cyui_gallery)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_gallery PUBLIC CyUI::ImGuizmo)
    endif()
endif()

# Compatibility target: the same API, with all modules enabled by this build.
add_library(cyui INTERFACE)
add_library(CyUI::CyUI ALIAS cyui)
target_link_libraries(cyui INTERFACE CyUI::Core)
foreach(module IN LISTS CYUI_ENABLED_MODULES)
    target_link_libraries(cyui INTERFACE CyUI::${module})
endforeach()
if(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO)
    target_link_libraries(cyui INTERFACE CyUI::Audio)
endif()
if(CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY)
    target_link_libraries(cyui INTERFACE CyUI::Gallery)
endif()

if(CYUI_BUILD_DEMO AND WIN32)
    if(NOT CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO OR NOT CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The full demo requires Audio and Gallery. Set CYUI_BUILD_DEMO=OFF for a selective library build.")
    endif()
    add_executable(cyui_demo WIN32
        examples/demo_win32_dx11/main.cpp
        ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp
        ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp)
    if(TARGET cyui_webcef)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_demo PRIVATE CyUI::WebCEF)
        target_compile_definitions(cyui_demo PRIVATE CYUI_DEMO_CEF=1)
        if(NOT CYUI_CEF_ROOT STREQUAL "")
            add_custom_command(TARGET cyui_demo POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}/Release" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:cyui_demo>"
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CYUI_CEF_ROOT}/Resources" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:cyui_demo>")
        endif()
    endif()
    target_include_directories(cyui_demo PRIVATE ${CYUI_IMGUI_DIR}/backends)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_demo PRIVATE CyUI::CyUI d3d11 dxgi d3dcompiler dwmapi shell32)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(cyui_demo PRIVATE /utf-8)
    endif()
endif()

if(CYUI_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_executable(cyui_test_features tests/features.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_test_features PRIVATE CyUI::CyUI)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_test_features)
    add_test(NAME cyui_test_features COMMAND cyui_test_features)
    add_executable(cyui_test_filtering tests/filtering.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_test_filtering PRIVATE CyUI::Core)
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_test_filtering)
    add_test(NAME cyui_test_filtering COMMAND cyui_test_filtering)
    function(cyui_module_test name target)
        add_executable(${name} tests/module_smoke.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${target})
        cyui_configure_target(${name})
        add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name})
    endfunction()
    cyui_module_test(cyui_test_core CyUI::Core)
    if(CYUI_BUILD_AUDIO)
        cyui_module_test(cyui_test_audio CyUI::Audio)
        target_compile_definitions(cyui_test_audio PRIVATE CYUI_TEST_AUDIO=1)
    endif()
    if(CYUI_BUILD_GALLERY)
        cyui_module_test(cyui_test_gallery CyUI::Gallery)
        target_compile_definitions(cyui_test_gallery PRIVATE CYUI_TEST_GALLERY=1)
    endif()
    cyui_module_test(cyui_test_compat CyUI::CyUI)
    target_compile_definitions(cyui_test_compat PRIVATE CYUI_TEST_COMPAT=1)
endif()

if(CYUI_BUILD_TESTS AND TARGET cyui_code)
    add_executable(cyui_test_code_languages tests/code_languages.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(cyui_test_code_languages PRIVATE CyUI::Code)
    if(TARGET cyui_codeeditor)
        target_link_libraries(cyui_test_code_languages PRIVATE CyUI::CodeEditor)
    endif()
    cyui_configure_target(cyui_test_code_languages)
    add_test(NAME cyui_code_languages COMMAND cyui_test_code_languages)
endif()
